summary: Reveals TMP text character by character, with an event on completion and an instant-complete call.
overview: Types text out rather than showing it at once. Exposes Play, CompleteInstantly and an OnTypingComplete event, which is what a dialogue runner needs to let a second click skip to the end of the line.
useCases: A tutorial or tip that draws attention as it appears.

params.tuning: Around 30-50 reads as natural speech. Above about 80 the effect stops being visible.
Turn off when something else owns the timing, such as a dialogue runner calling Play per line.

gotchas.title: Rich-text tags are not characters
gotchas.body: Tags reveal with the character they attach to rather than being typed out, which is what you want — but it means the visible count does not match the string length.
